entity_raw.definition_raw: Divine SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): MagicAssociated Deities: Aesdurath, Amaznen, Asmodeus, Barbatos, Isis, Korada, Kroina, Nalinivati, Nethys, Nyarlathotep (Black Pharaoh), Nyarlathotep (Faceless Sphinx), Nyarlathotep (Haunter of the Dark), Orcus, Qi Zhong, Sezelrian, Shyka, Skrymir, Tsathoggua, Urgathoa, YuelralReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the hand of the acolyte power of the Magic domain. Divine Vessel (Su): Whenever you are the target of a divine spell, you can, as a swift action, grant each ally within 15 feet of you a divine boon. This boon grants a +2 bonus on the next attack roll, skill check, or ability check made before the end of their next turn. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—bless water, 5th—cleanse, 7th—resurrection, 9th—miracle.
